page.overview:
Who is Piers Polkiss?

Piers Polkiss was a Muggle and Dudley Dursley's best friend.

Piers did not like Dudley's cousin Harry Potter, simply because Dudley didn't, and Piers always followed Dudley's lead.

On 23 June 1991, Dudley's eleventh birthday, Piers accompanied him, the Dursleys and Harry to the zoo. During the trip, Piers saw Harry talking to a snake in the reptile house. When Harry was pushed out of the way, and then unintentionally made the glass disappear, Piers and Dudley jumped back in surprise. When Piers told the Dursleys that Harry had been talking to the snake, they gave Harry his longest ever punishment.

During the summer of 1995, Dudley lied to his parents saying that he was at the Polkisses' having tea, although Piers was with Dudley's gang as they roamed the neighbourhood, often smoking, committing petty vandalism, getting into fights, or bullying younger kids.
